identifier_namespace: North Tyneside Strategic Sites FeatureServer SITE_NAME
evidence_slice: North Tyneside Council's Strategic_Sites_ FeatureServer exposes layer 0 as an esriGeometryPolygon dataset with two polygons representing Killingworth Moor or Murton Gap in British National Grid EPSG:27700; the layer metadata records a data last edit date of 17 October 2025. The Council's Killingworth Moor Masterplan states that Killingworth Moor is a Strategic Allocation in the North Tyneside Local Plan to deliver approximately 2,000 homes together with education facilities, local services, employment uses, green infrastructure and amenity space, on a site of approximately 190 hectares.

field_evidence.policy_context: North Tyneside Local Plan strategic allocation; Masterplan agreed by Cabinet

binding_method: authority-hosted polygon FeatureServer layer with exact SITE_NAME identifier plus council masterplan strategic-allocation evidence; canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
source_file_sha256_reason: The official FeatureServer metadata and council planning documents were accessed through public web transport; raw feature-query bytes and source PDF bytes were not acquired, so no source-file hash is fabricated.
